JSS2 SECOND TERM BASIC TECHNOLOGY EXAMINATION QUESTIONS - EDUDELIGHT.COM
Examination malpractices may lead to a repeat of the subject or suspensions don’t be involved.
Subject: BASIC TECHNOLOGY
Duration: 2HRS
Class: JSS 2
OBJECTIVE
- ___________ are basically four sided plane figure (a) Quadrilaterals (b) Polygons (c) Board practice (d) Drawing boards
- __________ all sides and angles are equal (a) Square (b) Rectangle (c) Trapezium (d) Kite
- __________ are plane figures bounded by more than four straight lines . (a) Trapezium (b) Square (c) Polygons (d) Kite
- Pentagon  has _______ Sides (a) 6 (b) 5 (c) 8 (d) 10
- Polygon with 8 sides is Called ________ (a) Heptagon (b) pentagon (c) Octagon (d) Decagon
- Polygon with Six Sides is Called _______ (a)Octagon (b) Hexagon (c) Decagon (d) Heptagon
- __________ is a Straight line which touches the circumference at a Point (a) Tangent (b) Arcs (c) Rectangle (d) Square
- ________ is a Plane figure bounded by three straight lines  (a) Rectangle (b) Triangle (c) Square (d) Trapezium
- _________ is a triangle that has three equal sides and three angles (a) Equilateral Triangle (b) Isosceles Triangle (c) Scalene Triangle  (d) Right angle Triangle
- __________ Can be defined as an operation organized to free from danger (a) First aid operation (b) Rescue operation (c) Responsive operation (d) Caring operation
- Which of the following cannot be regarded as a rescue operation (a) Vehicle-extrication rescue operation (b) Surface water rescue operation (c) Air - Sea rescue operation (d) First aiding
- Workshop accident includes the following except (a) Fracture (b) Bleeding (c) voltaging (d) Wound
- ________ is a table on which wood workers perform his operation (a) Workbench (b) Imperial board (c) Dove Tail table (d) Tenon Table
- Mixture of Sand, gravel, cement with water is Called (a) Plastering (b) rendering (c) Concrete (d) Plastics
- ________ is the name of buildings that contains many rooms on two floors (a) Duplex (b) Bungalow (c) hut (d) High - Rise
- Angles can be measured using ____ (a) French Curve (b) Compass (c) Protractor
- The instrument used for drawing irregular curve is called (a) divider (b)     Compass (c) Scale Rule (d) French Curve
- The following methods can prevent accident while working in the workshop, except (a) always use the right tools for each job (b) Always keeps to instructor (c) Avoid using worn out tools (d) Always do more than two jobs at the same time
- ________ are equipment used in order to achieve safety? (a) Safely devices (b) Fire extinguishers (c) Fire alarm (d) Fire buckets
- Metals can be classified into _______ (a) Six (b) Five (c) Four (d) two
- Papers are manufactured   from _______ ceramics (b) Ferrous (c) alloy (d) wood
- The major purpose of maintenance in engineering is to ________ (a) Keep it in good working condition (b) Prevent from making loud noise (c) Stop it from working too long (d)Enable it to last forever
- Workshop accident includes the following except (a) Fracture (b) Bleeding (c) Plastering (d) Wound
- One of the following is not among the rescue safely measures (a) Face cap (b) Safely boot (c) hand gloves (d) helmets
- First - aid can be used to care for the following except (a) Accident (b) Injury (c) Headache (d) Blood Donation
- __________ is used for transferring measurement (a) Divider (b) punches (c) Micrometer (d) Try square
- _________  is drawn at the bottom right hand corner of the drawing paper  (a) Boarder lines (b) Title block (c) Lettering (d) Figures
- _______ are poor conductors of heat and electricity (a) Plastics (b) Metal (c) Copper wire (d) Conductors
- ___________ Plastic can be softened into liquid form and remoulded (a) Thermosetting (b) Electric Plastic (c) Ceramic (d) Synthetic rubber
- Any material that allows free flow of electrons and electricity is Called _________ (a) Insulator (b) Conductors (c) Ceramics (d) Synthetic
- The brown material between electric poles and the electric wire is Called (a) Insulators (ceramic) (b) Thermoplastic (c) Synthetic (d) Vulcanization
- Glass belong to _________ family (a)  Plastics (b) Synthetic rubber (c) Thermo set Plastics (d) Ceramics.
- Which of the following can be used for drawing vertical and inclined lines ? (a) Protectors (b) Scale rule (c)  Compass (d) Set square
- Scale rules are used to produce (a) Reduced or enlarged sizes (b) Equal and normal size of drawing (c) Enlarged sizes of drawing (d) A good Linear drawing
- Which of the procedures comes first in Constructing a building (a) Excavation (b) concreting (c) Level (d) Site preparation
- Which of the following is not  a Quadilateral (a) Prism (b) Rhomboid (c) Rhombus (d) Parallelogram
- __________ are used to reduce wear and tear (a) Lubricant (b) Vulcanization (c) Synthetic (d) Abrasives
- Oil and Grease are used as_______ (a) Vulcanization (b) Lubricants (c) Synthetics (d) abrasives
- Polygon with (10) Ten sides is Called (a) Pentagon (b) Heptagon (c) Nonagon (d) Decagon
- We have                types of technology (a) 5   (b) 4    (c) 3    (d) 2
JSS2 SECOND TERM BASIC TECHNOLOGY EXAMINATION QUESTIONS - EDUDELIGHT.COM
THEORY:          Answer only three Question
1a Define Polygon             b   Construct the following polygon
i   Pentagon  AB   50mm             ii  Hexagon  AB    70mm        iii  Octagon   AB    70mm
2a Define Friction         b   State two advantages and two disadvantages of friction
c Differentiate between Lubrication and Lubricants
d Mention two Lubricant used in reducing friction
3a Explain five care and maintenance that must be given to wood work machines
b Explain two function of lathe machine
4 Sketch five workshop hard tools and Explain their uses
5a Explain the uses of the following technical drawing instrument
i Tee   Square
ii Protractor
iii Set Square
iv  Compass
v  Divider
b   Sketch tee square and label the parts
